title: Inline LaTeX ($...$) not rendering in Claude Code tab on Desktop app (macOS, Windows)
body:
## Description

Inline LaTeX using single dollar sign delimiters ($...$) does not render in the Claude Code tab within the Claude Desktop app on macOS and Windows. The text appears as literal plain text with visible dollar signs.

## Steps to Reproduce

1. Open Claude Desktop app on macOS
2. Use the Claude Code tab
3. Have Claude output inline math like $n = 3$

## Expected Behavior

Inline $...$ should render as formatted math, consistent with how $$...$$ display math renders.

## Actual Behavior

- $$...$$ (display math) renders correctly as formatted LaTeX
- $...$ (inline math) does **not** render — shows as literal text (e.g., $n = 3$)

## Environment

- Claude Desktop app (macOS)
- Claude Code tab
author: ostreion

top_comments.author: ostreion
top_comments.body: Clarification: this bug occurs in the **Claude Desktop app's Claude Code tab** on macOS. The inline LaTeX rendering ($...$) is not working there, while display math ($$...$$) renders fine. The rendering layer is likely the Desktop app's responsibility, not Claude Code CLI itself. Please redirect to the appropriate team if this is the wrong tracker. Thanks\!

top_comments.body: Same issue here. Happens in the recent few days after some update.
